description: a young slavic woman rogue for hire, short dark red hair, a sly half smile, amber eyes, a dark grey hood half down, a black scarf around her neck, a dark leather jerkin, dark trousers and soft boots, a short dagger in each hand, both daggers held the same way in a reverse grip with the blades pointing down and back along the forearms, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
